title: DFMethods.jl: A configurable framework for derivative-free projection methods for constrained nonlinear equations
description: DFMethods.jl provides a configurable framework for derivative-free projection methods for solving constrained nonlinear equations F(x) = 0 over closed convex feasibility sets, integrated with NonlinearSolve.jl. Components — search direction, line search, iterate-update strategy, inertial rule, constraint set, stopping criteria, and callbacks — are independently pluggable.
